verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents scoped API access tokens for building integrations. Its official CLI manages flags, members, projects, environments, teams and other resources, and its MCP server manages flags, AgentControl configs and observability data, which together suggest broad programmatic coverage. No evidence states that the API matches the UI, and the probe found no public OpenAPI spec at the standard paths, so the extent of parity is unproven. Missing for 10: an explicit API-UI parity statement, a published API reference or OpenAPI spec showing endpoint coverage, and independent hands-on corroboration that UI-only features (e.g., guarded rollouts, experiments, approvals) are reachable via the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: You can scope your API tokens to restrict the set of operations they can perform. For example, you can build an integration that only has read access
